name: Tracking
author: E. T. Carter
description: Bad VHS tracking — soft colour bands wobbling with tape jitter, chroma bleeding into red and blue ghosts, and a tracking-error band of snow rolling slowly up the picture while the bottom edge drops out. Warm analog decay.

params.label: Wobble
params.effect: Horizontal tape jitter and wavy warp; 0 is a steady picture, high is heavy wow and flutter.

params.label: Chroma bleed
params.effect: How far the colour channels smear into red/blue ghosts.

params.label: Tracking error
params.effect: Severity of the rolling desync band of snow; 0 removes it, high tears the picture.

params.label: Roll
params.effect: How fast the tracking band rolls through the frame; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer disturbs tracking at its row; 0 ignores the mouse.
